# MyDevTools - Privacy-First Developer Tools

## Overview
MyDevTools is a web-based developer tools platform built for privacy and speed. All processing runs locally in the browser using WebAssembly (WASM) and Rust. No user data is sent to servers.

## Core Mission
Provide fast, reliable developer utilities with a strict privacy-first architecture and transparent client-side processing.

## Key Features
- **100% Browser-Based Processing**: All tools run in the browser via WASM and Rust
- **Zero Server Transmission**: No user data is uploaded or logged
- **Privacy-Focused**: Safe handling for sensitive data and files
- **Instant Access**: No installs, no accounts, no setup
- **Full Control**: Clear, configurable options per tool

## Available Tools

### Encoding & Decoding
- **Base64 Encoder/Decoder**: Text and file Base64 processing
- **Base32 Encoder/Decoder**: Base32 encoding/decoding in-browser
- **Base58 Encoder/Decoder**: Base58 text and file processing
- **Hex Encoder/Decoder**: Hex encoding/decoding for text and files
- **URL Encoder/Decoder**: URL percent-encoding and decoding

### Data Formatting & Text
- **JSON Beautifier**: Pretty-print JSON with configurable formatting
- **XML Beautifier**: Format and beautify XML
- **YAML Beautifier/Validator**: YAML formatting and validation
- **Case Converter**: Convert text between common cases
- **Text Diff Viewer**: Compare and highlight text differences
- **Regex Tester**: Test patterns with live match preview
- **Markdown Preview**: Render Markdown locally

### Cryptography & Security
- **Hash Calculator**: MD5, SHA family, and more for text and files
- **HMAC Calculator**: HMAC generation for common algorithms
- **OpenSSH Keys**: Generate and convert SSH keys locally
- **X.509 Certificates**: CSR generation and certificate helpers
- **AEAD File Encryption/Decryption**: Encrypt/decrypt files in-browser
- **JWT Decoder/Encoder**: Decode and create JWTs locally

### Images
- **Image Converter**: Convert between common image formats locally
- **Image Compressor**: Reduce image file size in-browser
- **Image Resizer**: Resize images without uploads
- **Color Converter**: Convert between color formats
- **QR Code Generator**: Generate QR codes locally
- **QR Scanner**: Scan QR codes using local processing

### Utilities
- **Password Generator**: Generate secure passwords locally
- **UUID Generator**: Create UUIDs in-browser
- **Lorem Ipsum Generator**: Generate placeholder text
- **Date Converter**: Convert between date/time formats

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Blazor SSR, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- **Processing**: Rust compiled to WebAssembly (WASM)
- **Runtime**: .NET
- **Architecture**: SSR for HTML, client-side WASM for processing

## Use Cases
- Secure local processing for sensitive data
- Quick, zero-install developer utilities
- Offline-capable workflows (where supported by the browser)

## Interface & Accessibility
- **Responsive Design**: Desktop, tablet, and mobile
- **Internationalization**: Multiple languages (EN, RU, ES, DE, PT, ZH, FR, JA, KO, HI)
- **Dark Mode**: Theme toggle
- **Favorites**: Save commonly used tools

## Data Privacy Policy
- All processing occurs locally in the browser
- No uploads, no server-side processing
- No tracking required for tool usage

## Browser Compatibility
- Modern browsers with WebAssembly support (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

## Contact & Support
- Website: https://mydevtools.app/
